entries.ee795bb0cb5c0c9a: In the railway rolling stock business, the company's strengths are its ability to handle a wide range of vehicle types, including Shinkansen trains, limited express vehicles, commuter vehicles and business vehicles; it works to improve vehicle quality through digital technology and is advancing technology development in areas such as low-maintenance technology, condition monitoring and improved aerodynamic performance. In the steel structures business, the company is working to win orders for repair and maintenance work on road bridges, drawing on know-how accumulated through bridge repair work on the large-scale renovation of the Tokaido Shinkansen.

entries.fc46a37f534ca9b2: In its medium-term management plan 'Nissha Henkaku 2030', the company sets out a long-term vision for 2030 of 'becoming a business partner that delivers safety and reliability to the field smartly and solves customers' challenges', and promotes three pillars as priorities: 'thoroughly strengthening profitability', 'reforming the business foundation for growth' and 'realizing transformation of the business model'. As its corporate philosophy, the company states that it takes pride in manufacturing, responds to customer needs and contributes to the development of social infrastructure as an 'infrastructure-creating company'.
